title.en: Makala Maalum: The Complete Swahili Collection

subtitle.sw: Makala zote 8 katika kitabu kimoja cha PDF
subtitle.en: All 8 Swahili articles in one PDF book

description.sw: Kitabu pepe (PDF) kilichopangwa vizuri chenye makala zote za Makala Maalum: Sabato, Sanduku la Agano, Uungu wa Kristo, Pambano Kuu, Kalenda ya Gregory, Ibada na Milenia. Kinafaa kwa kujisomea, vikundi vya kujifunza Biblia na kuchapisha.
description.en: A beautifully typeset PDF e-book with every Makala Maalum article in Swahili: the Sabbath, the Ark of the Covenant, the Sonship of Christ, the Great Controversy, the Gregorian calendar, worship and the Millennium. Ideal for personal study, Bible study groups and printing.

subtitle.sw: Makala 6 za Kiingereza katika PDF moja
subtitle.en: All 6 English articles in one PDF book

description.sw: Makala zote za Kiingereza katika kitabu kimoja cha PDF — kwa ajili yako au kumpa rafiki anayesoma Kiingereza.
description.en: Every English Featured Article gathered into one elegant PDF e-book: the Ark of the Covenant, the meaning of “begotten”, why God created Lucifer, the Gregorian calendar and the Sabbath, kneeling in prayer and the Millennium.

title.en: Sabbath: A Memorial, Not a Shadow

description.sw: Makala mbili kuhusu Sabato zikiwa pamoja na maswali ya kujadili mwishoni mwa kila sehemu — zinafaa kwa Shule ya Sabato, vikundi vidogo na mafundisho ya ubatizo.
description.en: The two Sabbath articles together with discussion questions at the end of each part — ideal for Sabbath School, small groups and baptismal classes (Swahili).

subtitle.sw: Zawadi ya bure — Kiswahili na Kiingereza

description.sw: Pakua bure makala ya Milenia kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza katika PDF moja. Shiriki na marafiki zako!
description.en: Download the Millennium article in both Swahili and English as one free PDF. Share it with your friends!
